# Hook & Cook — San Clemente Pier

> Hook & Cook is the food counter and bait & tackle shop at the end of the San Clemente Pier, 615 Avenida Victoria, San Clemente, CA 92672. Seafood (lobster rolls, fish & chips, fish tacos), breakfast, coffee, shave ice, slushes, milkshakes, beignets, plus bait and tackle for pier fishing. Locally owned by Nicholas and Lauren Rivard (also owners of The Picnic Cafe in San Clemente). Opened 2026; city ribbon cutting September 4, 2026.

- Website: https://hookandcooksc.com/
- Phone: (949) 272-9391
- Order online (pickup): https://cash.app/$hookcookus
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hookandcookscpier/
- Location: the very end of the San Clemente Pier (walk out the pier; no car access). Coordinates approx. 33.4179, -117.6233.
- No alcohol served. Walk-up counter, no reservations.
- Fishing on the San Clemente Pier needs no California fishing license (public pier). Spiny lobster season Oct 2, 2026 to Mar 17, 2027.

## Hours
- Monday: 9am to 4pm
- Tuesday: 9am to 4pm
- Wednesday: Closed
- Thursday: 9am to 4pm
- Friday: 9am to sunset
- Saturday: 8am to sunset
- Sunday: 8am to sunset
